one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent repeatedly extracted only the upstream orig tarball into /app with --strip-components=1, discarding the required Debian packaging and pmars-* directory structure, so the verifier's directory checks failed despite a functionally working binary being produced.
t_err_evidence: tar -xf pmars_*.orig.tar.* --directory /app --strip-components=1 (extracts orig tarball only, discarding Debian packaging)
t_commit_evidence: Step 11 again downloads pmars_0.9.4.orig.tar.xz and extracts it into /app with --strip-components=1, cementing the wrong directory layout. After this point the agent proceeds to build and install the binary without ever reconsidering the source layout, making failure inevitable.
trigger_explanation: The agent assumed from the outset that extracting the upstream orig tarball into /app would satisfy the task requirement to use 'Debian sources' in /app, without verifying that the verifier expects a full Debian source tree (with debian/ directory and pmars-* subdirectory) rather than a flat upstream tarball extraction.
